description: A painted interior of an ornate salon with gilt-framed mirrors and wall sconces lit with candles. A woman with her hair pinned up stands in profile wearing a full green satin gown with ruffles and bows and a wide skirt. A seated woman in black watches with her hand to her chin. A man in a dark waistcoat kneels at the hem, adjusting the skirt. Dress and furniture suggest the mid-19th century. There is no visible text and no frame.
